svg.title: 01 · Key-Value Store: built step by step
svg.desc: Step 1: API Gateway + IAM. Client calls a REST API. Every method uses AWS_IAM; the client policy grants execute-api:Invoke, unsigned calls get 403. Step 2: Lambda. API Gateway proxies each request to one Python 3.12 Lambda that validates input. Step 3: DynamoDB. Lambda reads and writes an on-demand table keyed by 'key', with TTL on 'expiresAt'. Step 4: CloudWatch Logs. Lambda logs go to a dedicated log group with 14-day retention.
svg.text: 01 · Key-Value Store: built step by step

g.text: Client calls a REST API. Every method uses AWS_IAM; the client policy grants execute-api:Invoke, unsigned calls get 403.
API Gateway proxies each request to one Python 3.12 Lambda that validates input.
+ AWS::Lambda::Permission lets this API invoke the function
Lambda reads and writes an on-demand table keyed by 'key', with TTL on 'expiresAt'.
Lambda logs go to a dedicated log group with 14-day retention.
Everything above is one CloudFormation template: infrastructure/kv-store.yaml
